hooks.name: Enforce UI design rules on component save
hooks.description: Enforce UI design rules from .kiro/steering/ui.md after any frontend component is saved

action.prompt: A React component was saved. Review it against .kiro/steering/ui.md: check palette (neutral slate, blue-600 accent only), status colours (emerald/blue/amber/red/slate), no gradients/emoji/glassmorphism, 8px grid, Inter font, simulated connector labels. If any rule is violated, fix it in place.
